portable-types.number-any: Choose integer, float or decimal — `number` without a kind can't be compiled to C++, Go, Rust or C#.
portable-types.any: The `any` type can't be compiled to C++, Go, Rust or C# — choose a concrete type.
portable-types.enum: The `enum` type isn't supported by the C++, Go, Rust and C# targets — choose another type.
